A high-speed GT racing scene under falling snow — cinematic, ultra-realistic, 8K resolution. A sleek supercar accelerates in a straight line down a rain-wet asphalt track at night, tires roaring through slush and melting snow. Snowflakes drift gently through the air, illuminated by intense track lighting and piercing headlights. Vapor rises from the warm engine hood into the cold air, creating subtle condensation trails. Dynamic camera movements: low-angle tracking shot from behind, side dolly glide, and sweeping drone-like overhead pass. Motion blur emphasizes extreme speed, while every detail — tire tread, carbon fiber body, reflective wet surface — is rendered with photorealistic precision. The atmosphere is intense, silent yet powerful, filled with adrenaline and tension. No drifting, no sparks — pure raw acceleration in a cold, poetic, high-stakes environment. Cinematic lighting with deep shadows, blue-white color grading, and glowing reflections on the glossy black track. A visionary fusion of machine, speed, and winter stillness — like a moment from a futuristic racing film.
